info.name: Support Co-pilot (Valetax test task)
info.description:
Business API only (JSON): POST /tickets (helpdesk), GET /tickets (agent inbox), GET /tickets/{number}, GET /tickets/{number}/customer-details (audited), POST /tickets/{number}/decision (audited), GET /health (Docker).

Run: API `uv run python -m copilot.main` + worker `uv run copilot worker`, then Runner → Run collection (folders in order).

Auth: set collection variables helpdeskKey and agentKey (secret). Local keys: ~/.support-copilot-keys (create new ones: `uv run copilot keys new <name> <helpdesk|agent>`).

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: Server up, KB loaded from Postgres.

item.name: 1. Tickets
item.description: Tickets are background jobs: POST returns a ticket number at once (202), the worker runs the workflow, GET shows where it stands. Start the worker first: `uv run copilot worker`. Requests here use the HELPDESK key ({{helpdeskKey}}).

request.description: Masking + vault + enqueue happen here (~200 ms). The worker (`uv run copilot worker`) processes it in the background.

exec: pm.test("got a ticket number, status queued", () => { pm.expect(b.ticket_number).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("queued"); });
pm.test("Location header points to the status URL", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.eql(`/tickets/${b.ticket_number}`));
pm.test("no real PII value in the response", () => ["4111", "Ahmed Hassan", "A12345678"].forEach(v => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(v)));

item.name: 3. Ticket status (after the worker) → done + result

exec: // give the background worker a moment (real LLM runs take seconds: poll in a loop)
pm.test("done (is the worker running? uv run copilot worker)", () => pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("done"));

pm.test("every step reported with its own status; patterns first", () => { const nodes = b.steps.map(s => s.node); pm.expect(nodes[0]).to.eql("pattern_check"); pm.expect(nodes[nodes.length - 1]).to.eql("audit"); b.steps.forEach(s => pm.expect(["completed","placeholder"]).to.include(s.status)); });

pm.test("honest result: complete flag, placeholders never counted as completed", () => { pm.expect(b).to.have.property("complete"); const done = b.steps.filter(s => s.status === "completed").length; pm.expect(b.steps_completed).to.eql(`${done}/${b.steps.length}`); });

item.name: 4. Same ticket ID again → same number, nothing re-queued
6. Possible PII miss (mistyped card) → 202; see monitoring

request.description: Fails the Luhn check, so it is not masked as a card. Monitoring flags it: `uv run copilot logs --level WARNING`, Grafana panel 'Possible misses'.

exec: pm.test("401 without an API key", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: 2. Agent
item.description: What a support agent (through a frontend or the helpdesk) calls, with an AGENT key (collection auth: {{agentKey}}). The agent's name comes from the key. Run after folder 1.

exec: pm.test("rows count only real work", () => b.items.slice(0,5).forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.steps_completed).to.match(/^\d+\/\d+$/); pm.expect(r).to.have.property("complete"); }));

item.name: 4. Customer details with the helpdesk key → 403

exec: pm.test("403: only agents may see customer details", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

request.description: Recorded in logs/audit.jsonl as pii_revealed with the agent's name.
Placeholders are filled in for the customer at send time; stored and audited re-masked next to the AI draft.

exec: pm.test("recorded as edited by the agent", () => { pm.expect(a.decision).to.eql("edited"); pm.expect(a.agent).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: 3. pattern_check (every rule)
item.description:
One request per pattern_check rule: 5 injection, 2 security, 5 spam, plus edge cases (masked data only, spam + injection, a look-alike, a control). Each request creates a ticket with a unique id ({{$timestamp}}), waits for the worker and checks the result automatically (Test Results). Run the whole folder with the Collection Runner.

Today: injection → no LLM, senior_support · spam → low priority · security (exact phrase) → senior_support · everything else → support_agent, no_draft. Cases without a pattern (S4, N1, N2, P6) only check that NO pattern fired: the injection model may still add evidence (it has ~3% false alarms).

request.description: Creates the ticket (helpdesk key), waits for the worker, then checks pattern_check's result and the routing (agent key). Results: Test Results tab; details: Postman Console.

exec: // Expected result of pattern_check (and the routing it leads to) for this case.
// The worker processes it in the background: poll GET /tickets/{n} (agent key) until done.
const r = t.result || {}, rt = r.routing || {}, pat = r.patterns || {};
if (EXPECT.steps) pm.test("path through the graph", () => pm.expect(t.steps.map(s => s.node)).to.eql(EXPECT.steps));
pm.test("human_required (every ticket reaches a person today)", () => pm.expect(rt.decision).to.eql("human_required"));
pm.test("evidence never contains the customer's text", () => (rt.evidence || []).forEach(e => pm.expect(e).to.match(/^(pattern|spam|model|classifier|error):/)));
